scope: Actual XSim execution of pulse_loop.v with a scaled 1 MHz model clock and 100,000-cycle watchdog (100 ms), prepared for REA app replay. Testbench-generated input; no Pico execution, ARM/DDR simulation, analog co-simulation or physical hardware measurement. Board timing is verified separately at 125 MHz.

scenarios.label: Nominal 1 kHz
scenarios.description: Continuous 1 kHz stimulus; response toggles after each 1,000 rising edges.

assertions: Two healthy response transitions
First response follows 1,000 input rising edges
Fault and reset clear at end
1,000 input edges between response transitions
1.000 s response-transition interval
No post-startup watchdog fault

scenarios.label: Missing input / recovery
scenarios.description: Input held low from 1.100 to 1.350 s, then restored. The RTL fault clears on the next accepted edge.

assertions: Two healthy response transitions
First response follows 1,000 input rising edges
Fault and reset clear at end
Watchdog asserts 100 ms after last edge plus synchronizer latency
Fault auto-clears after input recovery
Response requires 1,000 new edges after timeout

scenarios.label: Stuck high / recovery
scenarios.description: Input held high from 1.1005 to 1.350 s. A high level is not a stream of edges; the watchdog still expires.

assertions: Two healthy response transitions
First response follows 1,000 input rising edges
Fault and reset clear at end
Watchdog asserts 100 ms after last edge plus synchronizer latency
Fault auto-clears after input recovery
Response requires 1,000 new edges after timeout

scenarios.label: Reset during operation
scenarios.description: Reset asserted from 1.150 to 1.200 s. Counting restarts; the RTL fault clears on the next accepted edge.

assertions: Two healthy response transitions
First response follows 1,000 input rising edges
Fault and reset clear at end
Synchronized reset asserts fault and clears response
Counting restarts after reset release
